rule.description: Codex started with full-access or no-approval mode
rule.info: Detects Codex CLI execution with flags that remove sandbox boundaries or approval prompts.
Falsepositives: Intentional use by approved admins or isolated lab systems.

rule.description: Codex started with risky permission configuration override
rule.info: Detects Codex CLI -c overrides that enable full access, disable approvals, or allow the danger-full-access permission profile.
Falsepositives: Intentional administrative testing in controlled environments.

rule.description: Claude Code started with permission bypass mode
rule.info: Detects Claude Code execution with flags that bypass normal permission prompts.
Falsepositives: Intentional use by approved admins or isolated lab systems.
Detects creation or modification of Codex configuration files. Enable FIM report_changes to let child rules inspect risky settings.

rule.description: Codex full-access or no-approval setting added or changed: $(file)
rule.info: Detects Codex config changes that enable danger-full-access, disable approvals, or allow the danger-full-access permission profile.
Requires FIM report_changes=yes on the monitored Codex configuration path.
Detects creation or modification of Claude Code settings and MCP configuration files. Enable FIM report_changes to let child rules inspect risky settings.

rule.description: Claude Code permission bypass or broad tool allowlist changed: $(file)
rule.info: Detects Claude Code settings that bypass permission prompts or broadly allow shell/file-editing tools.
Requires FIM report_changes=yes on the monitored Claude Code configuration path.

rule.description: AI agent MCP/tool integration configuration changed: $(file)
rule.info: Detects changes that add or modify MCP/tool integrations for local AI coding agents. Review the configured command, arguments, and target service.
